Sam: Heads-up — MedBridge wants a tight 14-day POC: intent routing + auto case summaries. They need clear success gates (latency/cost/quality), infra blockers (KMS, VPC), and a burn estimate.
Renee: Do we have expected RPS/concurrency? that determines Dedicated sizing.
Sam: They expect ~70 reqs/min steady, spikes to ~210. Avg convo ~560 tokens. Targets: routing p95 <400ms, summary p95 <800ms.
Ibrahim: Security checklist: customer-managed KMS, EU data residency, SIEM export. Can we run Dedicated in eu-west-1 and peer VPCs? @Kai
Kai: Yes — Dedicated in eu-west-1 available. For POC we can disable persistent KV cache, use customer KMS, and forward logs to Splunk.
Renee: Draft acceptance gates: routing accuracy >=92% on a 500-chat eval; summary quality: ROUGE-L >=0.62 OR human agreement >=85% on 200 samples; latency as above; cost target <= $0.016/1k input tokens; reliability: fallback to quantized distill if error rate >1% or latency >900ms for 5m.
Sam: Sample eval prompts for Eng-ML: 
```
System: You are a concise summarizer. Return JSON keys: summary, action_items.
User: "Summarize the conversation and list next steps for ops."
```
Ibrahim: Data handling: confirm transient sessions, no persistent storage unless customer opts in, all blobs encrypted with customer KMS, optional PII redaction.
Kai: deploy-bot: Reserved Dedicated (2xA10G) eu-west-1 2026-09-01 08:00 UTC -> 2026-09-15 08:00 UTC. I'll add a deploy snippet to the runbook and plan a 4-hour load test on day 2.
Renee: Who owns the runbook and eval harness? I can own eval metrics if Sam drafts runbook.
Sam: I'll draft runbook today and loop in Eng-ML. Next: finalize thresholds with MedBridge by EOD tomorrow, finish security Q responses, sign SOW, then spin Dedicated. :white_check_mark:
